hero.title: Sanskar
hero.tagline: Building software, developer tools, and digital products in the open.
hero.intro: My work and interests span Rust and C++, Android, the web, game development, and AI/machine learning — built in public on GitHub and shared with the developer community.

about_paragraphs: I'm Sanskar, a software developer. My interests cover a wide range of software: systems languages such as Rust, C, and C++; Android development with Kotlin and Java; web development with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React; C#, .NET, and Python; game development; and AI and machine learning.
I build in the open on GitHub, take part in the developer community, and create digital products along the way. This website brings all of that together in one place.
